name: Soybean Crush Spread — Processing Margin Monitor
description: CBOT board crush spread: (ZM × 0.022 + ZL × 0.11) − ZS/100, in $/bushel. Shows the gross processing margin for soybean crushers. Exhibits: crush level with 1Y moving average, seasonal monthly pattern, and historical percentile context with summary stats.
source:
# =============================================================================
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush
# Formula: (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS / 100)
#   = ZM × 0.022 + ZL × 0.11 − ZS × 0.01
# All values in $/bushel of soybeans crushed
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: Load all three soybean complex contracts ---
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()

# Build continuations (NoAdjustment — we need raw price levels for the spread formula)
zs = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)
zm = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)
zl = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# ffill reference data to avoid NaN gaps on calendar misalignment
zs_close = ffill(zs.c)
zm_close = ffill(zm.c)
zl_close = ffill(zl.c)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# ZS quoted in cents/bushel, ZM in $/short ton, ZL in cents/lb
# Board crush: meal value (44 lbs per bushel / 2000 lbs per ton) + oil value (11 lbs per bushel)
# All converted to $/bushel
meal_value = zm_close * 0.022       # $/ton × 44/2000 = $/bushel from meal
oil_value = zl_close * 0.11         # cents/lb × 11 lbs / 100 cents = $/bushel from oil
bean_cost = zs_close * 0.01         # cents/bushel / 100 = $/bushel

crush_spread = meal_value + oil_value - bean_cost

# --- Trend & Context ---
crush_ma252 = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush_spread)

# Historical percentile (1-year rolling)
crush_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(crush_spread)

# Lifetime stats via cumulative
crush_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(crush_spread)
crush_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(crush_spread)

# --- Seasonality ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Event Markers: Extreme crush levels (top/bottom 10th percentile) ---
is_extreme_high = is_valid(crush_pctrank) and crush_pctrank >= 90
is_extreme_low = is_valid(crush_pctrank) and crush_pctrank <= 10

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Crush Margin',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Meal Value', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='Oil Value', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='Bean Cost', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush_spread, crush_pctrank, meal_value, oil_value, bean_cost, is_extreme_high or is_extreme_low)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Crush Spread Level with 1Y Moving Average
# Question: "Where is the crush margin now, and is it above or below trend?"
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Is the Crush Margin Above or Below Trend?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_spread, crush_ma252))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Seasonal Monthly Pattern
# Question: "Which months have the widest/narrowest crush margins?"
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='When Is the Crush Margin Widest?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_label='Avg $/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=crush_spread, label=month_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Summary Table — Current Snapshot
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Crush Spread',
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Margin Snapshot',
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Current', 'Percentile (1Y)', '1Y Range'],
        col_headers=['Value', 'Context'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(crush_spread, crush_ma252, crush_pctrank, crush_ma252, crush_min, crush_max)
